Platform: Ignite UI for Angular

Variables created: $proposal-card

```scss
// Generated by Ignite UI Theming MCP Server
// Custom card theme
// NOTE: @use rules must be at the top of the file. Deduplicate when combining multiple outputs.
@use "igniteui-angular/theming" as *;

// Custom card theme
$proposal-card: card-theme(
  $schema: $light-material-schema,
  $background: var(--app-navy-600)
);

// Apply the theme to .proposal-card
.proposal-card {
  @include tokens($proposal-card);
}
```

> **File placement:** `@use` rules must appear at the very top of the `.scss` file, before any other statements. When combining outputs from multiple tools, keep only one `@use` per module path.

---
**Usage:** Import this Sass file in your main styles file, or include the code in your theme file.
